summary: Blue Springs is a city in Jackson County, Missouri, located 19 miles east of downtown Kansas City. The note says it is the eighth largest city in the Kansas City Metropolitan Area. As of the 2010 census its population was 52,575, tying it for 10th largest city in Missouri with St. Peters. CNN / Money Magazine ranked it 49th among the 100 Best Places to Live in the United States in 2010.
one_line: Blue Springs is a Missouri city in Jackson County, east of Kansas City, with a 2010 population of 52,575.
key_facts: Blue Springs is a city located in the U.S. state of Missouri and within Jackson County.
Blue Springs is located 19 miles (31 km) east of downtown Kansas City, Missouri.
Blue Springs is the eighth largest city in the Kansas City Metropolitan Area.
As of the 2010 United States Census, the population of Blue Springs was 52,575.
In the 2010 census, Blue Springs tied with St. Peters for 10th largest city in the state of Missouri.
In 2010, CNN / Money Magazine ranked Blue Springs 49th on its list of the 100 Best Places to Live in the United States.
